settings.title: Settings
settings.lang.title: Language
settings.mode.title: When to coach
settings.mode.reviewDesc: Speaks only after you discard: decide first, then compare.
settings.mode.liveDesc: Suggests a tile as soon as you draw. It answers before you decide — in-game assistance.
settings.mode.warn: ⚠ Live mode answers before your discard. That is in-game assistance. Third-party tools reading match data may violate the Mahjong Soul ToS — friend rooms only, at your own risk.
settings.tiles.title: Tiles
settings.tiles.darkDesc: Tiles stay hidden until you press one. Useful when streaming or recording.
settings.port.title: Port
settings.port.hint: If you change the port, update the userscript URL too (default 18766; usually no need).
settings.env.title: Environment
settings.wallpaper.title: Panel wallpaper
settings.wallpaper.hint: mp4 / webm / png / jpg / gif / webp (≤64 MB). Panel height follows the image ratio; refresh the game page after uploading.
settings.maint.title: Maintenance
settings.saveHint: Applies immediately — no restart, no page refresh.
settings.wp.none: Current: no wallpaper (solid background, fixed 520px height)
settings.wp.uploaded: Uploaded — refresh the game page to apply
settings.wp.restored: Restored default — refresh the game page to apply
setup.title: Mahjong Soul Coach · First-time setup
setup.env.okDetail: Python runtime found · VC++ runtime OK
setup.env.noPy: Python runtime not found — the engine cannot start (run the installer again to repair)
setup.env.noVc: Install “Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64)” and restart the coach
setup.model.liteHint: Lite model in use — download the full one
setup.model.noneHint: No model weights; the engine cannot give advice
setup.model.done: Downloaded — restart the coach to load it
setup.script.hint: Without Tampermonkey you will land on its install page; with it, the install dialog appears.
setup.script.fallback: If the new tab shows raw code with no Install button, Tampermonkey is missing or disabled — click “Install Tampermonkey first”.
setup.game.detail: Open Mahjong Soul and start a match; the “coach N frames” badge in the bottom-left means it is connected.
setup.foot: Server {{ver}} · port {{port}} · this page is served on 127.0.0.1 only and never talks to the internet (except the model download you start).
setup.noServer: The server is not responding — make sure the coach is running.
boot.liveWarn: ⚠ Live mode: answers before your discard — in-game assistance.
boot.liveRisk: Third-party tools reading match data may violate the ToS. Friend rooms only, at your own risk.
panel.title: 🦋 Mahjong Soul Coach
setup.script.staleHint: Language changed but the userscript is still the old one — reinstall it below, then refresh the game page. The badge can lag a few seconds.
settings.lang.hint: Saving jumps to the setup wizard: step 3 must reinstall the userscript before the panel switches language.
